method: Public-source research and bounded link checks. No calls, applications, personal outcomes or live inventory checks. Provider reports are attributed; a recognized provider is not a guarantee of current access.

reviews.finding: CHOMP’s 2025 assessment, page 146, reports providing lab work and diagnostic testing to RotaCare Monterey patients. This independently documents care delivered; the clinic page supplies the current appointment route.
reviews.limits: Appointment availability and suitability for an individual were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: CHS and 211 describe outpatient substance-use assessments and agree on 831-237-7222 and 831-383-7800. The short headline is original editorial encouragement, not an attributed quote or a guarantee of recovery.
reviews.limits: No appointment, coverage decision or individual outcome confirmed. Provider age wording is inconsistent; the existing instruction to ask which program serves the caller’s age group is retained.

reviews.finding: The City of Gonzales independently identifies CCES energy-bill assistance and the same application phone. The provider FAQ confirms required documents and the application process.
reviews.limits: Current funds and approval for any particular household were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The City of Gonzales and CCES describe weatherization for eligible owners and renters. The provider confirms that renters also need the owner’s agreement.
reviews.limits: No assessment appointment, installed measure or individual energy saving was confirmed.

reviews.finding: California’s Department of Aging lists Alliance on Aging as Monterey County’s HICAP provider. The provider confirms free counseling and the program phone; its unfinished online appointment page is not used.
reviews.limits: Appointment openings and individual insurance savings were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: County records document a 2025–26 meals contract. The current provider page describes home delivery and intake. The old contract is historical corroboration, not proof of current funding or an available delivery route.
reviews.limits: Current enrollment, route coverage and a start date must be confirmed with the program.

reviews.finding: California’s Department of Aging includes Meals on Wheels Salinas in its 2025 nutrition-program stories. The provider currently publishes home-delivery eligibility and intake. Testimonials are not an independent effectiveness study.
reviews.limits: Enrollment and the first delivery date were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: Monterey County Bar Foundation identifies Legal Services for Seniors as a 2025 grant recipient providing free help to county residents age 60+. The provider confirms services and intake phone.
reviews.limits: Case acceptance, appointment availability and legal results were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: California Department of Education’s indexed resource-and-referral listing matches the provider and 831-757-0775. Direct CDE retrieval was blocked; the current provider page confirms that families receive options and must contact each childcare provider about space.
reviews.limits: A referral does not secure childcare, a subsidy, or a vacant place.

reviews.finding: 211 independently lists CCCIL assistive-technology services. A fresh provider-page fetch confirms the program and 831-757-2968. This documents assessment/device assistance, not guaranteed free equipment.
reviews.limits: Device inventory, suitability, cost and loan eligibility were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The Workforce Development Board’s 2024 impact report describes job-search, training and placement support. The current service-center page supplies the contact route. The report is provider-published, not an independent job-outcome evaluation.
reviews.limits: Enrollment and any particular job or training placement were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The City of Santa Cruz’s November 2025 statement independently recognizes Second Harvest’s food-distribution role. The current foodbank page lists its food hotline and locator. The historical funding pledge is not treated as current available funds.
reviews.limits: A hotline referral does not confirm food stock or pickup access at a specific site.

reviews.finding: City recognition corroborates Second Harvest as a local food provider; its current CalFresh page documents application help and the hotline. Foodbank assistance is separate from the county’s benefit decision.
reviews.limits: Individual eligibility, benefit amount and approval were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: Second Harvest is independently recognized by the city. Its diaper page identifies public distribution partners separately from partners serving enrolled clients. The card links to the public list.
reviews.limits: Diaper stock, sizes, hours and each partner’s intake conditions were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The California State Bar’s 2026 legal-aid grant recipient list includes Watsonville Law Center. Its contact page documents public intake instructions and limited availability. Business and existing-client numbers are not presented as new-client intake.
reviews.limits: No case acceptance, legal outcome or immediate appointment was confirmed.

reviews.finding: The county’s indexed housing-program page identifies its ECHO counseling arrangement. Direct county retrieval was blocked. ECHO’s current page lists Monterey-area tenant/landlord counseling, mediation and the county phone.
reviews.limits: This is counseling/referral; no rent payment, legal representation or dispute outcome is promised.

reviews.finding: The SPCA’s 2025 report states that its Pet Food Bank distributed 152,180 pounds of food. This is a provider-reported delivery total. The current recipient page specifically says critical need and confirms Saturday pickup and limits.
reviews.limits: Current stock and food types were not confirmed. This is help during critical need, not a stock-up offer.

reviews.finding: A San Benito County-hosted ADRC directory independently recognizes Del Mar and its service region. That directory is historical; the current provider page supplies eligibility, contact and support options.
reviews.limits: Respite funds, copays and appointment openings must be confirmed. No caregiver health outcome is guaranteed.

reviews.finding: MST’s published FY2025 figures report 186,167 RIDES passenger trips. Its current ADA page documents eligibility and the application process. Trips are not a count of unique people or proof of availability for a requested journey.
reviews.limits: Individual eligibility, service corridor and advance booking must be confirmed.

reviews.finding: The city library is a real public service, but its old adult-learning deep link returned 404 on a fresh request. Its replacement city page does not substantiate the specific tutoring waitlist and access details in this card.
reviews.limits: Held from Ready until current tutoring instructions are confirmed.

reviews.finding: United Way’s 2025 annual report documents 12,308 phone/text contacts and approximately 18,750 referrals. Its two referral totals differ slightly, so no exact referral total is repeated. Referrals are not confirmed successful assistance.
reviews.limits: No promise that a referred agency has space, funding or accepts a particular applicant.

reviews.finding: MST is the public transit district. Its current travel-training page documents free instruction in planning and taking bus trips. System ridership does not establish a specific training-completion or independence outcome.
reviews.limits: A training appointment or personal outcome was not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The city confirms the library system, but the old computers/Wi-Fi deep link returned 404 on a fresh request. Current guest-pass and session-length rules have not been re-established from the replacement page.
reviews.limits: Held from Ready until current computer-access instructions are confirmed.

reviews.finding: The city confirms the library system, but the old Wi-Fi details page returned 404 on a fresh request. The replacement page does not establish the advertised 8 a.m.–8 p.m. access window.
reviews.limits: Held from Ready until the current Wi-Fi access window is confirmed.

reviews.finding: The police website identifies Salinas Connect as the city-service channel. Its linked portal returned 404 in fresh requests while the web index still showed an older portal page; the current submission route is unresolved.
reviews.limits: Held from Ready until the service-request destination loads successfully. No request was submitted.

reviews.finding: MST’s official district website links its service-alerts page. This is an operational information tool for riders, not a benefit or a guarantee that every disruption has been posted.
reviews.limits: Check the live route information before traveling; no service availability or all-clear is promised.

reviews.finding: The county’s indexed food-resource page recognizes this Food Bank. The current provider schedule explicitly lists 11/5/26, 9–10 a.m., Our Lady of Refuge, 11140 Preston Street. The fresh HTML and web reader agree; stale 2024 rows were excluded.
reviews.limits: Pickup operation and stock were not confirmed directly. This card expires at the listed event end.

reviews.finding: The county’s indexed food-resource page recognizes this Food Bank. The current provider schedule explicitly lists 11/6/26, 9–10 a.m., St. Philip’s, 8065 Carmel Valley Road, for seniors and the general public. Old-year rows were excluded.
reviews.limits: Pickup operation and stock were not confirmed directly. This card expires at the listed event end.

reviews.finding: The provider publishes meal and pantry schedules. Santa Cruz Local’s December 2025 guide corroborates the location, phone and services.
reviews.limits: No same-day food stock or holiday opening was confirmed.

reviews.finding: 211 corroborates the no-fee meal service and address. Current provider resources and contact pages specify the meal times.
reviews.limits: Meal availability on a particular day was not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The Chamber recognizes the day center and services. The provider supplies current weekday schedules and enrollment instructions; an older Saturday listing is not reused.
reviews.limits: No shelter bed, voucher, funding award or same-day appointment was confirmed.

reviews.finding: California Public Health lists Monterey County as an authorized WIC agency. The county’s own application page supplies the text-to-apply number.
reviews.limits: Individual eligibility, appointment availability and callback timing were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The state WIC directory lists Community Bridges and both participant phone numbers. The provider explains eligibility and appointments.
reviews.limits: Office-day inconsistencies are not presented as confirmed hours; enrollment and available appointments were not verified.

reviews.finding: The regional transportation commission’s 2025 guide independently lists Lift Line. The provider describes multiple programs with different eligibility and fares.
reviews.limits: No trip, vehicle availability or individual fare was confirmed.

reviews.finding: Santa Cruz Public Libraries independently lists this provider and intake phone. Current delivery frequency and application instructions come from Community Bridges, rather than older directory wording.
reviews.limits: No open delivery route, waitlist position or start date was confirmed.

reviews.finding: The CPUC’s current program instructions identify the enrollment route and official administrator website.
reviews.limits: Eligibility, cellular coverage, plan price and device availability must be confirmed with the participating provider.

reviews.finding: PG&E’s current residential application lists the same enrollment phone and income guidelines valid through May 31, 2027.
reviews.limits: An individual discount, approval and account eligibility were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The current program page and provider application explainer agree on practitioner certification, non-income eligibility and the application phone.
reviews.limits: Individual medical eligibility, savings and continuous power supply are not guaranteed.

reviews.finding: California DDS and San Andreas Regional Center publish the same Monterey County Early Start assessment number.
reviews.limits: No assessment appointment, diagnosis or service eligibility was confirmed.

reviews.finding: The county publishes its service and appointment route; the statewide county veterans service officers association corroborates the phone.
reviews.limits: Appointments and individual benefits determinations were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The county contact page and county veterans officers association agree on both phone numbers. The county supplies the current Watsonville address.
reviews.limits: No appointment or benefits award was confirmed; the association’s older Watsonville address is not reused.

reviews.finding: The county hospital’s financial-assistance page and published policy agree on the application office, phone and address.
reviews.limits: An individual discount or debt cancellation was not confirmed.

reviews.finding: California’s official service listing corroborates the DHCS dental directory and member assistance number.
reviews.limits: Current individual coverage, treatment authorization and appointments were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The county’s current Ways to Apply instructions explicitly name the phone application number and link the BenefitsCal portal.
reviews.limits: No individual eligibility, processing time, benefit amount or office appointment was confirmed.

reviews.finding: The county’s CalWORKs page explains the application and interview; its customer-service page identifies the benefit application phone.
reviews.limits: Eligibility, funding, payment timing and appointment availability were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The county housing authority lists Mountain Community Resources and the same phone. The provider specifies benefits assistance and the discontinued services.
reviews.limits: No appointment, benefit approval or grant was confirmed.

reviews.finding: The regional homeless-services coalition’s guide corroborates Safe Place. Current ages, check-in and distinct services at each site come from CHS.
reviews.limits: No vacant bed or same-day admission was confirmed.

reviews.finding: AMBAG’s regional transportation plan lists the provider and medical travel service. The provider’s current service overview and contact page supply eligibility and intake.
reviews.limits: A specific ride, gas grant or appointment transport was not confirmed.

reviews.finding: The county education office’s housing guide lists the eviction assistance line. Community Bridges currently describes the collaborative and access number.
reviews.limits: No representation, payment or legal outcome was confirmed.

reviews.finding: The provider currently lists November 2026 workshops and individual-support contacts. United Way’s 211 listing corroborates the program and phone.
reviews.limits: No class seat, individual appointment or family outcome was confirmed.

reviews.finding: The county specifies local application contacts and locations; California Social Services confirms the county application and assessment process.
reviews.limits: No eligibility, paid hours or caregiver placement was confirmed.

reviews.finding: YWCA and 211 agree on the 24-hour domestic-abuse line and safety-planning service. YWCA reports providing safe-house nights and advocate calls in 2025; those are provider-reported activity, not an independent outcome measure.
reviews.limits: No live call answer, shelter vacancy or individual outcome was tested.

reviews.finding: Monarch’s help and contact pages and United Way’s 211 listing agree on the support line and service area.
reviews.limits: No live call response, shelter space or appointment was confirmed.

reviews.finding: The city’s program and detailed enrollment pages identify the service area, assistance types, documentation and enrollment-help number.
reviews.limits: Individual eligibility, current funding and a credit amount were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: County and state agree on the 24/7 substance-use access number. The county also documents weekday assessment/support offices in Santa Cruz and Watsonville. Original motivational wording makes no promise of treatment or recovery.
reviews.limits: An access and referral service, not a confirmed appointment or placement. Individual eligibility, insurance coverage, program availability and outcomes were not confirmed.

reviews.finding: Rechecked November 7, 2026: CDC fentanyl guidance documents mixing into illicit drugs and counterfeit pills, potentially deadly levels and inability to identify fentanyl by sight, taste or smell. CDC naloxone guidance documents slowed/stopped breathing, brain damage or death during overdose, opioid-overdose reversal and calling 911/staying with the person. CDPH page retrieved successfully and contains Naloxone Finder; no local stock or free availability promised. Sources: https://www.cdc.gov/overdose-prevention/about/fentanyl.html ; https://www.cdc.gov/overdose-prevention/reversing-overdose/about-naloxone.html ; https://www.cdph.ca.gov/Programs/CCDPHP/sapb/Pages/Naloxone.aspx Local pickup sources reviewed November 7: County Health Department 1270 Natividad Road; MPC Student Center 980 Fremont Street; Santa Cruz SUOPP 1060 Emeline Avenue Room 105. Hours and stock limits are explicit in the caption. MST 110 Salinas Street kiosk launch is documented, but continued operation after the original October 31 agreement term and stock were NOT verified; caption says call first, not confirmed current. Sources: https://mpc.edu/news/narcan-vending-machine.html ; https://mpc.edu/about/campuses-and-centers/contact-us.html ; https://santacruzhealth.org/PublicHealth/InfectiousDisease/CAReTeamIntegratedServices/SafeUseandOverdosePreventionProgram.aspx ; https://www.countyofmonterey.gov/government/departments-a-h/health/behavioral-health/bh-home/opioid-safety-information-and-resources-espa-ol ; https://www.countyofmonterey.gov/Home/Components/News/News/11308/18?arch=1&npage=9&widgetId=41 ; https://mst.org/privacy-policy/
reviews.limits: Online source verification only; no live stock check or call. Salinas Transit Center current operation remains unconfirmed and is specifically qualified. Existing review deadline retained.
